initialExam.title: PFRDA Grade A Officer 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
initialExam.description: PFRDA recruits Grade A Officers to regulate National Pension System (NPS) and pension funds in India.
initialExam.syllabus: Phase I: English, Reasoning, Quant, GA, Pension/Finance. Phase II: Descriptive, Domain.
initialExam.examPattern: Phase I: 200 marks. Phase II: 100 marks. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Phase I → Phase II → Interview → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Grade A Officer in PFRDA for pension regulation
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade A → Grade B → DGM → GM → ED.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit pfrda.org.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, NPS, Housing loan benefits
